A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, beside the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-infantrymine-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Infantry Mine (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the 2018 E card. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the bottom right, beside the game-text box.

The whole of the 2018 E card and the whole of the disc card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
